objective: Teach learners to classify a ticket as urgent or routine while distinguishing determined outcomes from unsupported conclusions.
rule_summary: If outage=true, then the ticket is urgent.
The supplied rule gives no consequence for outage=false; it does not establish that such a ticket is routine.
overlap_diagnosis: No existing examples were supplied, so there is no repetition to consolidate.
